task.title: Say who made this tree
task.shortdesc: Add your name, or the name of a group, as the maker of your tree.

context.p: The page lists the people or groups credited with the tree. It is usually only you. The name marked (default) is named as the maker when you save the tree.

stepresult.p: If nobody is credited yet, the page says Nobody is credited with this tree yet. Use the + button to add a name.
